│ At 2,700 lines, does the parity bar still include the
│ low-value gesture rows? Two-finger tap hides the
│ soft-key toolbar (143 lines), three-finger swipe cycles
│ sessions on coarse Android only (105), and both need a
│ shared multi-touch registration module first (113). That
│ is 361 lines for two gestures.

❯ 1. Drop all three (Recommended)
     361 lines out. Touch scroll, pinch-zoom and the
     compose mirror stay, since those are how you scroll,
     size and type. The two gestures are conveniences you
     can ask for later if you miss them.
  2. Keep everything, full parity
     Port all 2,700 lines including both gestures. Nothing
     about today's terminal changes for you, at the cost
     of the longest path to the flip.
  3. Keep two-finger tap, drop the swipe
     The toolbar hide is the one you would notice on a
     tablet; session cycling has a UI equivalent. Costs
     the multi-touch module regardless, so 256 lines.
  4. Type something.
